headline: Nadella warns all AI models should be treated as compromised
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella used a lengthy Saturday post on X to argue that AI models should be assumed compromised and that the industry needs an 'emergency brake.' He said it is time to reassess AI's 'trust architecture' rather than treat AI systems as a 'set of nested black boxes' whose outputs are simply accepted.
